name: Appartement Greier
beschreibung: Appartement Greier is situated in a quiet residential area in Tyrol, Austria. The holiday apartment offers cosy furnishings with a separate living area, kitchen, and balcony with mountain views. Guests can look forward to private accommodation with convenient access to nearby hiking and cycling trails. The central location provides an ideal base for excursions into the Tyrolean Alps. On-site parking is available.
